svg.title: Spead AI Pro for WIKA: value
svg.desc: 6 quote statuses, from verified to not found, checked before a person sees an answer; 0.933 Recall@5 with hybrid search and reranking, up from 0.867 with keyword search (synthetic test set); 0.909 MRR@10 with hybrid search and reranking, up from 0.824 with keyword search (synthetic test set); 0.2 to 0.6 Recall@5 on cross-language queries (Indonesian question, English clause or the reverse), keyword versus hybrid with reranking; 99 API test files run on an in-memory database with two companies
svg.text: Numbers from the product and its pilots.
